svg.title: Verifiable Intent mandate pair state held by the network
svg.desc: State diagram: Verifiable Intent mandate pair state held by the network. 5 states: Unfulfilled, Fulfilled, Recurring (agent_recurrence), Exhausted, and Expired. Starts in Unfulfilled. Ends in Fulfilled, Exhausted, and Expired. 5 transitions. From Unfulfilled to Fulfilled when Network accepts the first L3a for the pair (None defined in the spec). From Unfulfilled to Recurring (agent_recurrence) when First L3a accepted with mandate.payment.agent_recurrence present. From Recurring (agent_recurrence) to Recurring (agent_recurrence) when Further L3a within counters and budget. From Recurring (agent_recurrence) to Exhausted when Counter, budget or end_date limit reached. From Unfulfilled to Expired when L2 exp passes before fulfillment.
